name: faq_agent
description: Answers Dayuse FAQ and policy questions (cancellation conditions, how day-use works) via the read-only MCP_B2C server; stateless — profile in/out through the A2A DataPart.

skills.name: faq_conditions
skills.description: Given query_params (a question about Dayuse conditions, policies, or how day-use works) plus profile_in, returns {results, profile_delta, diagnostics} from the read-only MCP_B2C tool get_faq_conditions. Stateless: no session, no Redis.

bearer-interim.description: Interim static bearer over the private network (D7 exception, unsigned card); replaced by oidc-mtls at the latest before the S11 canary.
